Container.Name: plMail
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted mail client with a calendar beside it. Reads the IMAP, Gmail and Outlook mailboxes you already have in one inbox.
Needs a PostgreSQL 18 container: install one first, then enter its address and password in Database URL. All other secrets are generated on first start into the appdata folder. Back that folder up: it holds the encryption key for the stored mail passwords.
Serves plain HTTP. For HTTPS, put it behind your reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager).
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL 18 container (for example from Community Applications, or the official postgres:18 image).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface (plain HTTP).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Secrets (including the encryption key), attachments, raw messages and uploads. Back this up.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DATABASE?serverVersion=18&charset=utf8 (HOST is the Postgres container's name on a custom network, or the server's IP on the default bridge). Must contain the password.

Config.Name: Encryption key
Config.Description: Leave empty to have one generated (recommended). Only set it to bring the key of an existing install along.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: Single sign-on: the issuer URL of your identity provider (Authentik, Keycloak, ...). Leave empty to use passwords only.

Config.Name: All in one
Config.Description: Runs web server, workers and the live-update hub in this container. Leave at 1.

Config.Name: Storage directory
Config.Description: Where plMail keeps its files inside the container. Leave as is.

Config.Name: Secrets directory
Config.Description: Where the generated secrets live inside the container. Leave as is.

Config.Name: Secrets file
Config.Description: The generated secrets file inside the container. Leave as is.
